brief: A storage box whose lid is held shut with magnets.

requirements.evidence: Single hex base (piece:0,0,0;full) with full-depth drop-in bin (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full) forms enclosed storage volume ~176x153x80mm; open side faces capped with solid caps.

Full cover on top face (cover:0,0,0;full;top) acts as lid; covers include magnets by default - verified by setCoverMagnets refusal 'already has its magnets in' when trying to enable them. Lid seats magnetically on base rim.

finish.summary: Built single-cell storage box: hex base + full-depth bin + full top cover. Cover includes integrated magnets that hold lid shut, verified via configurator. Side faces capped and joints locked.

events.text: Your magnetic-lid box is next — I'll make a closed storage body that snaps shut with magnets.
